name: Pi-hole clients
author: Netlens
description: Reads the network table of Pi-hole v6: every device that asked Pi-hole for a DNS answer, with its MAC address, current IP address, the host name Pi-hole resolved for it and the manufacturer it looked up. Netlens matches them to what it finds on the network by MAC address and uses the names and manufacturers. Read-only: it only reads the table. (To register names in Pi-hole, use the Pi-hole DNS plugin.)

info.title: Use an app password
info.text: In Pi-hole: Settings > Web interface / API > Configure app password. Pi-hole only knows devices that sent it queries and that are on the same network segment (it reads their MAC address from the neighbour table), so devices behind a router appear with the router's MAC address.

config.label: Only devices seen in the last days
config.help: Pi-hole keeps devices forever; older ones are left out.
